practice. At the present time, the most commonly encountered nutritional problem seen in clinical 
practices in the United States and many developed countries is obesity and its associated complica­
tions. Specific clinical signs that are attributable to nutrient deficiencies and significance on physical 
examination are shown in Table 1-4. Combined nutrient deficiencies are still seen in those with 
disordered intake such as alcoholics or patients receiving chemotherapy.
